title: Run Centrifuge using iMicrobe
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.spuednw

steps.title: Select Mock Communities
steps.instruction: Navigate to the iMicrobe sample search page and select the desired mock communities to add them to your cart.

steps.title: Launch Centrifuge App
steps.instruction: Open the 'tools' dropdown menu, select 'Apps', and click on centrifuge-1.0.4u1.

steps.title: Configure Centrifuge Parameters
steps.instruction: Provide the input files from the cart and configure the application parameters based on the data type.

substeps.instruction: Set Index to 'Bacteria, Archea, Viruses and human (compressed)'.
For 454 reads (10 million reads per file), use standard settings or optionally set 'Exclude' to 562 and 287 to remove E. coli and P. aeruginosa.
For Illumina paired-end reads (1 million reads per file), ensure files are named in the format MYFILENAME_1.fast(a/q) and MYFILENAME_2.fast(a/q) to match pairs.

steps.title: Retrieve Results
steps.instruction: Once the job has run, access the output files via the CyVerse datastore.

substeps.instruction: Go to the 'Tools' dropdown menu and select 'Jobs'.
Select the specific centrifuge run and navigate to the 'Outputs' section.
Click 'Browse and view output files in the CyVerse Datastore'.

steps.title: Analyze Output Files
steps.instruction: Navigate to the 'centrifuge-out' folder in the CyVerse datastore to review the results.

substeps.instruction: Review the 'figures' folder for bubble plot visualizations (hits < 2% abundance are removed) and the accompanying CSV file containing species names and proportions.

Review the 'reports' folder for *.sum files (8 columns: read ID, genomic sequence ID, taxonomic ID, classification score, next best classification score, matching base pairs, read length, and number of classifications).

Review the 'reports' folder for *.tsv files (7 columns: genome name, Taxonomic ID, taxonomic rank, genome length in bp, number of reads classified to genome, number of uniquely classified reads, and normalized proportion).
